purpose: Package non-executable historical Python extracts without altering their measured bytes or exempting source from license checks.
license: The project LICENSE is included in the archival bundle. Executable evaluator sources retain their normal required license headers.
history: Original loose extracts, original seals and their original commit remain unchanged in the original evaluation checkout. The integration checkout publishes their exact bytes in this new add-only archive instead of introducing the loose extracts. Original source-path references in historical provenance resolve to archive member names.
results: All recorded trial outcomes, provider costs, calibration and correction records remain unchanged.
